boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Touro University
boards.description: Ten food-focused, under-21-safe destinations around Touro University’s 3 Times Square campus, each with directly listed current late hours.

cards.title: Raising Cane’s at 1501 Broadway
cards.subtitle: 1501 Broadway, Times Square
cards.notes: Use the walk-up window for a late carryout stop; the location lists restaurant service through 3 AM and walk-up service through 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Times Square food counter with clearly posted late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its 1501 Broadway location as open daily until 3 AM, with its walk-up window open until 2 AM.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's — Broadway, New York
cards.access_notes: Restaurant service is listed daily until 3 AM; dine-in and walk-up window service are listed until 2 AM.

cards.title: Empanada Mama on West 40th Street
cards.subtitle: 200 W 40th St, Times Square
cards.notes: Check the day before heading over: this Times Square shop lists 1 AM closes Sunday–Wednesday and 3 AM closes Thursday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: A nearby empanada shop with later hours later in the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Empanada Mama lists its Times Square location at 200 W 40th Street and hours until 1 AM Sunday–Wednesday and 3 AM Thursday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Empanada Mama — Locations and Hours
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: 8 AM–1 AM Monday–Wednesday, 8 AM–3 AM Thursday–Friday, 10 AM–3 AM Saturday, and 10 AM–1 AM Sunday.

cards.title: 2 Bros. Pizza on Eighth Avenue
cards.subtitle: 557 8th Ave, Times Square
cards.notes: Use this as a simple slice-stop option near the campus corridor; the official location page lists daily service until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Times Square pizza counter with a nightly 2 AM listed close.
cards.evidence_claim: 2 Bros. Pizza lists its Times Square location at 557 8th Avenue as open daily from 10 AM to 2 AM.
cards.source_title: 2 Bros. Pizza — Times Square Location
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 10 AM–2 AM.

cards.title: 2 Bros. Pizza by Port Authority
cards.subtitle: 542 9th Ave, Midtown West
cards.notes: If you are already walking west of Times Square, confirm this separate location’s counter before going; it lists service every day until 2 AM.
cards.short_summary: A distinct Ninth Avenue 2 Bros. location with late listed hours.
cards.evidence_claim: 2 Bros. Pizza lists its Port Authority location at 542 9th Avenue as open daily from 10 AM to 2 AM.
cards.source_title: 2 Bros. Pizza — Port Authority Location
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 10 AM–2 AM.

cards.title: Junior’s on 45th Street
cards.subtitle: 1515 Broadway at 45th Street
cards.notes: Plan a seated meal or bakery pickup before midnight on most nights; Friday and Saturday service is listed through 1 AM.
cards.short_summary: A Broadway restaurant and bakery with a documented midnight-or-later schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Junior’s lists its 45th Street restaurant at 1515 Broadway as open until midnight Sunday–Thursday and until 1 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Junior's — 45th Street, NYC
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 7 AM–12 AM Sunday–Thursday and 7 AM–1 AM Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Carnegie Diner on Eighth Avenue
cards.subtitle: 828 8th Ave, Times Square
cards.notes: Use the all-day diner format when you need a seated food option after evening classes; its official page lists service through 1 AM daily.
cards.short_summary: A diner near Times Square with a consistent 1 AM listed close.
cards.evidence_claim: Carnegie Diner lists its Times Square location at 828 8th Avenue as open seven days a week from 7 AM to 1 AM.
cards.source_title: Carnegie Diner & Café — Times Square
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists daily hours of 7 AM–1 AM.

cards.title: Glass House Tavern on West 47th
cards.subtitle: 252 W 47th St, Theatre District
cards.notes: For a later seated dinner, check the day-specific closing time before leaving campus; the restaurant lists 1 AM or 2 AM closes.
cards.short_summary: A Theatre District restaurant with day-by-day late dinner hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Glass House Tavern lists closing times of 1 AM on Sunday and Monday, and 2 AM Tuesday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Glass House Tavern
cards.access_notes: Listed hours vary by day: Sunday and Monday end at 1 AM; Tuesday through Saturday end at 2 AM.

cards.title: Los Tacos No. 1 on West 43rd
cards.subtitle: 229 W 43rd St, Times Square
cards.notes: Use this just off the campus block for a food-only stop; it lists a midnight close Monday through Saturday and 10 PM on Sunday.
cards.short_summary: A West 43rd Street taqueria with a midnight weekday-and-Saturday schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Los Tacos No. 1 lists its Times Square location at 229 W 43rd Street as open until midnight Monday–Saturday and until 10 PM Sunday.
cards.source_title: Los Tacos No. 1 — Times Square
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 11 AM–midnight Monday–Saturday and 11 AM–10 PM Sunday.

cards.title: ICHIRAN on West 49th Street
cards.subtitle: 152 W 49th St, Times Square
cards.notes: For a later ramen dinner, arrive before the last seating window: the restaurant says seating can stop 40–60 minutes ahead of closing.
cards.short_summary: A Times Square ramen restaurant with posted late evening hours and early last seating.
cards.evidence_claim: ICHIRAN lists its Times Square restaurant at 152 W 49th Street as open until 10:30 PM Monday–Thursday and Sunday, and until 11 PM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: ICHIRAN — Times Square
cards.access_notes: Listed close is 10:30 PM most nights and 11 PM Friday–Saturday; the restaurant notes that seating may stop 40–60 minutes before closing.

cards.title: Times Square Diner & Grill on Eighth Avenue
cards.subtitle: 807 8th Ave, Midtown West
cards.notes: Keep this as an earlier-late option for diner food and pickup; the restaurant’s own site lists daily hours ending at 11 PM.
cards.short_summary: An Eighth Avenue diner with a documented nightly 11 PM close.
cards.evidence_claim: Times Square Diner & Grill lists its address as 807 8th Avenue and its daily opening hours as 7 AM to 11 PM.
cards.source_title: Times Square Diner & Grill
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Monday–Sunday hours of 7 AM–11 PM.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Free, public cultural and outdoor activities in Manhattan, with access details verified from official institutions and agencies.

cards.entity_name: Polonsky Exhibition of The New York Public Library's Treasures
cards.title: Browse NYPL's Treasures
cards.subtitle: Gottesman Hall, Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
cards.notes: Meet at Gottesman Hall and move through the permanent display together; leave time to compare one object each before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A free permanent exhibition of collection highlights spanning 4,000 years.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL identifies the Polonsky Exhibition as an ongoing, free exhibition at the Stephen A. Schwarzman Building.
cards.source_title: Polonsky Exhibition of The New York Public Library's Treasures
cards.access_notes: Free exhibition; check the page for temporary exhibition closures and building-entry timing.

cards.title: Take the NYPL building tour
cards.subtitle: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building Visitor Center
cards.notes: Reserve a spot for the one-hour docent tour, then meet in the Visitor Center at the listed start time for a shared look at the building.
cards.short_summary: A free, docent-led introduction to NYPL architecture, history, and collections.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL offers free one-hour building tours Monday through Saturday at 11 AM and 2 PM; tickets are required.
cards.source_title: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building Tours
cards.access_notes: Free, but limited to the first 20 people who reserve online; meet in the Visitor Center.

cards.title: See the Rose Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
cards.notes: Arrive early for the weekday visiting hour and take in the reading room from the designated visitor access window; research seating is separate.
cards.short_summary: A historic reading room with a free daily visitor-access period.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL states that visitors may see the Rose Main Reading Room during free visiting hour, 10–11 AM Monday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
cards.access_notes: Free visiting hour runs 10–11 AM Monday–Saturday; final entry is 10:50 AM.

cards.entity_name: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building Rooftop Terrace
cards.title: Pause on NYPL's rooftop terrace
cards.subtitle: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
cards.notes: Use the building’s public terrace as a low-key stop between classes; follow posted building rules and confirm any same-day access changes before going.
cards.short_summary: A publicly accessible rooftop terrace at NYPL's flagship building.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL says visitors may use the Stephen A. Schwarzman Building's free publicly accessible rooftop terrace.
cards.source_title: About the Stephen A. Schwarzman Building
cards.access_notes: The terrace is publicly accessible; enter during building hours and follow current library access rules.

cards.title: Explore Federal Hall's galleries
cards.subtitle: 15 Pine Street entrance, Financial District
cards.notes: Walk through the exhibit galleries at your own pace, then stop outside for the George Washington statue and the historic Wall Street façade.
cards.short_summary: A fee-free national memorial with exhibit galleries and self-guided access.
cards.evidence_claim: The National Park Service says admission to Federal Hall National Memorial is free and self-guided visits do not require reservations.
cards.source_title: Fees and Passes - Federal Hall National Memorial
cards.access_notes: No entrance pass is required; confirm current opening status before traveling.

cards.title: Join a Federal Hall ranger tour
cards.subtitle: Federal Hall National Memorial, 15 Pine Street
cards.notes: Join the ranger for the scheduled one-hour orientation, then use the remaining time to revisit the exhibit that caught your group’s attention.
cards.short_summary: A recurring, free ranger-led tour of Federal Hall National Memorial.
cards.evidence_claim: NPS lists the Ranger-Guided Tour of Federal Hall as free; reservations are recommended but walk-ins are welcome.
cards.source_title: Ranger-Guided Tour of Federal Hall
cards.access_notes: Free; scheduled at 10:30 AM on listed days through 2027. Reservations are recommended, not required.

cards.entity_name: Writers Workshop at Bryant Park Reading Room
cards.title: Write outdoors at Bryant Park
cards.subtitle: Reading Room, Bryant Park
cards.notes: Bring a notebook and join the outdoor workshop, then stay afterward to swap a favorite prompt or a few lines with friends.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor writing workshop in Bryant Park's Reading Room.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists the Writers Workshop at Bryant Park Reading Room as a free summer writing workshop.
cards.source_title: NYC Parks Talks Events
cards.access_notes: Listed as free by NYC Parks; check the official calendar for the scheduled date and weather updates.

cards.entity_name: Nature Talks at Bryant Park Reading Room
cards.title: Catch a Nature Talk
cards.subtitle: Reading Room, Bryant Park
cards.notes: Meet at the Reading Room for the outdoor lecture, then take a lap through the park and discuss one new idea from the speaker.
cards.short_summary: Free, outdoor nature lectures led by local experts.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists Nature Talks at Bryant Park Reading Room as free outdoor lectures led by local experts.
cards.source_title: NYC Parks Talks Events
cards.access_notes: Listed as free by NYC Parks; verify the particular lecture's date, time, and weather status.

cards.title: Talk movies at Reel Talks
cards.subtitle: Reading Room, Bryant Park
cards.notes: Use the film conversation as a ready-made group plan: arrive a few minutes early, listen in, and compare takeaways after the discussion.
cards.short_summary: A free Bryant Park conversation series focused on movies and filmmaking.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists Reel Talks at Bryant Park as free talks on movies, cinema culture, and filmmaking.
cards.source_title: NYC Parks Talks Events
cards.access_notes: Listed as free by NYC Parks; consult the calendar for the specific talk's schedule.

cards.title: Hear an author conversation
cards.subtitle: Reading Room, Bryant Park
cards.notes: Pick a listed Author Series session, meet at the Reading Room, and bring one question or theme to unpack together afterward.
cards.short_summary: A free Bryant Park program featuring author discussions and advice.
cards.evidence_claim: NYC Parks lists Bryant Park Author Series events at the Reading Room as free.
cards.source_title: NYC Parks Talks Events
cards.access_notes: Listed as free by NYC Parks; dates and featured speakers vary, so confirm the calendar entry.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each

cards.title: Times Square Pedestrian Plazas — car-free pause

cards.title: TKTS Booth — same-day theater tickets

cards.notes: Check the board for same-day Broadway and Off-Broadway availability, then decide whether the listed discount and show time fit your plan.

cards.title: Bryant Park Lawn — outdoor programming

cards.title: Bryant Park Reading Room — scheduled literary events

cards.notes: Use the park calendar to find a Reading Room talk or workshop, and arrive with enough time to locate the programmed area.

cards.evidence_claim: Bryant Park’s current calendar lists Reading Room author events and a fiction-writing workshop.

cards.title: NYPL Main Branch — research collections

cards.source_title: Stavros Niarchos Foundation Library (SNFL)
cards.access_notes: NYPL lists the library as fully accessible and publishes current branch hours on its location page.

cards.title: Grand Central Terminal — transit and architecture
cards.subtitle: East 42nd Street at Park Avenue
cards.notes: Walk east along 42nd Street to the main entrance and use the terminal’s official map to locate the concourse or transit connections.
cards.short_summary: A public terminal with rail, subway, bus, and architectural details.
cards.evidence_claim: Grand Central Terminal lists its main entrance at 89 East 42nd Street and identifies subway, bus, Metro-North, and LIRR connections.
cards.source_title: Visit - Grand Central Terminal
cards.access_notes: The terminal is listed as open to the public daily; individual businesses and services have separate hours.

cards.title: Empire State Building — landmark exterior
cards.subtitle: West 34th Street between Fifth and Sixth Avenues
cards.notes: Approach via West 34th Street and use the official directions page to choose a subway route before deciding whether to book an observatory visit.
cards.short_summary: An identifiable Art Deco landmark on the 34th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: The Empire State Building’s official visitor information places the building at 20 West 34th Street and provides walking and subway directions.
cards.source_title: Empire State Building Address & Directions
cards.access_notes: The official page provides directions; check the attraction’s current ticketing information separately if entering the observatory.

cards.title: Morgan Library & Museum — research-library setting
cards.subtitle: Madison Avenue at East 36th Street
cards.notes: Head east from the Fifth Avenue corridor to 225 Madison Avenue, then consult the museum’s visit information for exhibitions and admission details.
cards.short_summary: A museum and non-circulating research library on Madison Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Morgan states that it is located at 225 Madison Avenue at 36th Street and is a museum and non-circulating research library.
cards.source_title: The Morgan Library & Museum Frequently Asked Questions
cards.access_notes: The Morgan lists Free Friday Evenings with advance reservations; regular admission and exhibition details should be checked before visiting.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Touro University, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A grounded Midtown-to-Manhattan weekend sequence built around Touro’s 3 Times Square campus and public cultural destinations.

cards.entity_name: Touro University Cross River Campus at 3 Times Square
cards.title: Start at 3 Times Square
cards.subtitle: Touro’s Manhattan campus; 3 Times Square
cards.notes: Begin by orienting yourself at the campus address, then use the nearby subway connections to choose a simple first outing.
cards.short_summary: Set your starting point at Touro’s Manhattan campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Touro identifies its Manhattan Campus at 3 Times Square, New York, NY 10036.
cards.source_title: Our Campuses | Touro University Graduate School of Social Work
cards.access_notes: Campus access may be limited to Touro students, employees, and invited visitors.

cards.title: Get your bearings in the Broadway plazas
cards.subtitle: Times Square; Broadway plazas from 42nd to 48th Streets
cards.notes: Take a daylight walk through the pedestrian plazas and use the public seating as a brief pause before heading east.
cards.short_summary: A public, accessible midpoint for getting oriented in Times Square.
cards.evidence_claim: The Times Square Alliance says public seating is available throughout the Broadway plazas from 42nd Street through 48th Street.
cards.source_title: Accessibility Resources for Times Square
cards.access_notes: Open public space; the Alliance notes quieter workweek periods are typically 10–11 a.m. and 1–6 a.m.

cards.title: Borrow a read at the Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Bryant Park; north side near the 42nd Street plaza
cards.notes: In the April–September season, borrow a book, magazine, or newspaper to read in the park under the yellow umbrellas.
cards.short_summary: A seasonal open-air reading stop with free-to-read material.
cards.evidence_claim: Bryant Park says its Reading Room lends books, magazines, and newspapers for reading in the park daily from 11 a.m. to 7 p.m. from April through September.
cards.source_title: Nature Talks at Bryant Park's Reading Room
cards.access_notes: Seasonal service runs April–September, daily 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; check the park for weather-related changes.

cards.title: See the library’s landmark interiors
cards.subtitle: New York Public Library; Fifth Avenue and 42nd Street
cards.notes: Reserve a free docent tour for a focused look at the building’s architecture, collections, and Rose Main Reading Room.
cards.short_summary: A free guided introduction to NYPL’s flagship building.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL offers free one-hour docent-led tours of the Stephen A. Schwarzman Building at 11 a.m. and 2 p.m., Monday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building Tours | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Reserve online; tours are limited to the first 20 people. The building’s accessible entrance is at 40th or 42nd Street.

cards.title: Make a library stop at SNFL
cards.subtitle: 455 Fifth Avenue, New York
cards.notes: Browse the circulating collection, then check whether the rooftop terrace is open before making it your next Midtown pause.
cards.short_summary: NYPL’s large circulating branch beside Bryant Park.
cards.evidence_claim: NYPL identifies SNFL at 455 Fifth Avenue and describes its rooftop terrace as a free outdoor public space with Midtown views and open-air seating.
cards.source_title: Stavros Niarchos Foundation Library (SNFL) | The New York Public Library
cards.access_notes: Regular library hours are listed on NYPL’s location page; the rooftop terrace can close for weather.

cards.title: Choose a gallery visit at MoMA
cards.subtitle: 11 West 53 Street, Manhattan
cards.notes: If you want an indoor art stop, book admission and leave time for the collection galleries before their listed closing time.
cards.short_summary: A ticketed Midtown museum visit with daily public hours.
cards.evidence_claim: MoMA lists its Manhattan location at 11 West 53 Street, daily hours, and paid adult and student admission options.
cards.source_title: Locations, hours, and admission | MoMA
cards.access_notes: Open daily except Thanksgiving and Christmas; galleries close about 15 minutes before museum closing. Timed admission is required.

cards.title: Walk through Rockefeller Center Plaza
cards.subtitle: Rockefeller Center; 30 Rockefeller Plaza area
cards.notes: Use the plaza as an outdoor architecture and public-art stop, then check the Center’s calendar if you want to add programming.
cards.short_summary: An all-day public plaza within Rockefeller Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Rockefeller Center states that its plaza is open 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
cards.source_title: Private Events Inquiries | Rockefeller Center
cards.access_notes: The plaza is open 24/7; individual shops, restaurants, attractions, and holiday hours vary.

cards.title: Look up at Grand Central Terminal
cards.subtitle: 89 East 42nd Street, New York
cards.notes: Walk through the terminal’s public concourse and use the official visitor page to identify current exhibits or guided-tour options.
cards.short_summary: A publicly accessible historic terminal near Midtown’s east side.
cards.evidence_claim: Grand Central Terminal lists its address as 89 East 42nd Street and says it is open to the public daily from 5:15 a.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: Visit | Grand Central Terminal
cards.access_notes: Public daily hours are 5:15 a.m.–2 a.m.; individual businesses and the Dining Concourse have separate hours.

cards.entity_name: Public Square and Gardens at Hudson Yards
cards.title: Pause in Hudson Yards’ Public Square
cards.subtitle: Hudson Yards; Public Square and Gardens
cards.notes: Finish an afternoon with the landscaped square’s shaded outdoor seating, keeping the climbable centerpiece optional and within posted rules.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor gathering space with gardens and seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Hudson Yards describes the Public Square and Gardens as having expansive parks, gardens, and shaded outdoor seating.
cards.source_title: Public Square and Gardens in NYC | Hudson Yards
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–9 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–7 p.m.; observe posted site rules.

cards.title: Close with a Central Park walk
cards.subtitle: Central Park, Manhattan
cards.notes: Pick one well-marked route, carry what you need, and check the Conservancy’s alerts and closures before heading into the park.
cards.short_summary: A large public park for a self-paced final walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The Central Park Conservancy lists park hours as daily from 6 a.m. to 1 a.m. and directs visitors to alerts and closures for updates.
cards.source_title: Plan a Visit | Central Park Conservancy
cards.access_notes: Open daily 6 a.m.–1 a.m.; consult current alerts and closures before visiting.
